# Circle by Fractionl

> Save any clue about a person. Circle joins the details quietly and brings back the right person when they can help.

Last updated 2026-08-10. This file describes the active product at circle.fractionl.ai. Older descriptions of a two-tab Plan/Circle product, a relationship-to-revenue engine, overnight drafted Moves, or $30/$79 tiers are retired.

## Who it is for

Fractional executives and independent operators who meet useful people across client work, events, introductions, social profiles, and phone contacts, but do not want to maintain a CRM.

Not for sales teams that need deal stages, seat management, pipeline administration, or automated outreach.

## What it does

1. Accepts a name, link, email, note, voice clue, photo, supported device contact, or Android PWA share.
2. Preserves the raw clue and asks only for a missing name. Where the user met the person is optional.
3. Uses the existing ingestion, fingerprint, and dedupe pipeline to keep one grounded person.
4. Finds a directly named saved person without an LLM or paid search dependency.
5. Uses provider-backed search or ranking for broader requests when available.
6. Recovers from provider failure with local matching over saved name, title, company, tags, notes, and dossier evidence.
7. Shows why the person matched and never sends a message automatically.

The signed-out root is a visual front door. The signed-in root is one adaptive working plane for `Keep clue` or `Find`. There is no active Plan tab or CRM dashboard.

## Inputs

- text, pasted links, email, phone, and notes
- voice through a user-tapped Whisper control
- profile and business-card photos
- supported device contacts
- Android PWA share target for images, text, titles, and URLs

Native iOS share-sheet intake and an official Apple Shortcut are not shipped. Do not place a long-lived Supabase token in a Shortcut or URL.

## Trust rules

- A name is the only required save field.
- Nothing saves until the user taps the save action.
- The raw clue is preserved.
- Uncertainty and correction stay visible.
- Match reasons come from saved evidence.
- Circle never claims interest, availability, or relationship strength without evidence.
- Circle never sends a message automatically.
- Exact saved-name recall remains available when provider-backed paths fail.

## Pricing

The current code catalogue contains Free and Pro. Pro is listed at $39 per month in `src/lib/tiers.ts`. Do not quote a trial, $30 plan, or $79 plan. Wider network search may be plan-gated; exact recall of a person the user already saved is not.
